# Loading Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```


# Loading data

```{r}
lifts <- read.csv("../data/raw/Teambuildr Raw Data Report Andrew Lamb.csv")

head(lifts)
```

# Looking at the data

```{r}
lifts <- lifts |> 
  group_by(Exercise.Name) |> 
  mutate(Times.lifted = n()) |> 
  arrange(desc(Times.lifted))


```
